baseline_workbook.path: data/Hungry F&B Database.Public Access 2026-10-17 Verified Menu Catalogue Refresh 40.xlsx

eligibility_method: Only rows with at least one blank coordinate and public-access status were screened. Proposed candidates require exact six-digit postal and exact source address/building identity; facility coordinates must be labelled facility-level. Postal-only overlaps, ambiguous identities, non-public locations, and records with coordinates already populated are excluded.
